items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: on one of my trips I had Barbara Joy and another girl, this Jeri Dean

ctx.x: In the sixties; yeah. I went in the Sands in '62, the Atlantic Beach Hotel in '63, Sands, four, five and

six, but in between there--you see, the Sands was just a seasonal job, so in between there I would go to Greenland and on one of my trips I had Barbara Joy and another girl, this Jeri Dean--I must be lucky with singers, because she got to be the star of The Me That Nobody Knows and Me and Bessie, and also she was the queen of the automobile show about four years ago--four or five years ago--Jeri Dean, and of course Alberta Hunter; she did very well.
